title: Nepal tragedy: Owners missing, dog refuses to leave flood-hit Trishuli home
summary_full: A black-and-white dog remains at the site of four homes destroyed by a flood.  He refuses to leave the muddy patch where his home once stood.  Rescue workers and JCBs clear debris around the steadfast canine.  Volunteers offer food and water, which he accepts quietly when alone.  Displaced residents understand his loyalty to his former territory.
